split_policy.primary_axis: diagnostic phase before recovery negative directory label, generated report, report-only row, old-mode label, shim label, fallback label, compatibility label, migration label, runner label, or e2e label
split_policy.negative_rule: recovery negative fixtures are canonical rejection, strict diagnostic, or provenance evidence only; no row in this family defines positive parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, e2e, acceptance, or capability support
split_policy.parser_rule: lexer/parser diagnostics own O3L* and O3P* rejection fixtures, malformed tokenization, missing punctuation, missing operands, malformed declarations, misplaced qualifiers, invalid literals, unterminated constructs, and draft-syntax parser rejections
split_policy.sema_rule: semantic diagnostics own O3S* rejection fixtures, type mismatch, undefined symbols, arity mismatch, unsupported type suffixes, return-path failures, pure/extern semantic violations, generic/protocol/nullability conflicts, conservative switch/loop/condition rejections, and cross-module semantic contracts
split_policy.lowering_ir_runtime_e2e_rule: lowering, IR, runtime, and e2e owners may route negative evidence only as fail-closed rejection or strict-error evidence; they do not inherit positive support from rejected source, generated reports, runner-only success, or directory labels
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode recovery, compatibility recovery, shim recovery, fallback recovery, generated-only recovery, report-only recovery, migration-only recovery, wrapper-only recovery, runner-only success, e2e execution-only success, and any generated/report row promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
